results.title: Teen Spirits
results.overview: In a deserted high school, a group of teenagers gathers for a mysterious choral ritual.

results.title: Man in Hanbok
results.overview: Jang Yeong-sil, a genius scientist, rises from slavery to the rank of jong sam pum (Senior Third Rank) thanks to King Sejong's favor, but after the palanquin incident of 1442, he disappears completely from historical records. Where did he go? In 20th-century London, a painting by Rubens titled "Man in Hanbok" appears in an auction at Christie's. The identity of this unknown Asian figure painted by Rubens traces back to the era of King Sejong in the 15th century. Though born a slave, Jang Yeong-sil possessed exceptional brilliance. However, he receives an order from Ming China demanding that he be executed or handed over to them. With King Sejong's help, he escapes by joining the Ming explorer Admiral Zheng He on a voyage to Europe and even meets the Pope in Italy. But Jang's belief that the world is round is deemed heretical, and the Pope orders his execution. Fleeing for his life, Jang reaches Florence alone, where he encounters a seven-year-old Leonardo da Vinci.

results.title: When Worlds Collide
results.overview: Lana Maxwell becomes the prime suspect in the murder of her friend Veronica. Watch as her life unfolds and she deals with the challenges that being a teenager brings. Meanwhile Evelyn Jackson is going through friend group problems, and decides to make friends with a controversial figure.

results.title: PURK - The Movie
results.overview: PURK – THE MOVIE is an all-new director’s cut of the TV 2 series, re-edited into a feature film and featuring new, exclusive scenes. Narcotics investigator Lisa refuses to accept that her husband, Jostein, died while on a police assignment. Convinced that the truth is being hidden from her, she begins her own investigation—one that gradually draws her into a world of crime, corruption, and unexpected alliances.

results.title: Chuuraa
results.overview: In the remote Siberian Arctic, an Indigenous Sakha scientist descends into the depths of the melting permafrost. Searching for an ancient creature, he makes his way through the dangerous, claustrophobic caves to the mythical realm of the Underworld.

results.title: The Power of Positive Murder
results.overview: Working off his crippling rent debt, an aimless grad student toils away his summer break under the thumb of his evil landlord. When his disdain for his landlord reaches its peak, he concocts a devious plan to get rid of her for good.

results.title: Songs for Selina
results.overview: Musical soulmates Maya and Selina are torn apart by the cutthroat music industry. Only Selina is deemed a star, forcing Maya into the shadows as a ghostwriter, while Selina rises to fame.

results.title: Lakásavató
results.overview: Having recently moved back home, a young couple hosts their high school friends in their new apartment.

results.title: All Saints Street - The Secret of the Old Castle
results.original_title: 万圣街 特别篇 古堡的秘密
results.overview: A Halloween special for All Saints Street. The supernatural roommates of Room 1031 find their daily lives of rent, chores, and bickering interrupted by a mysterious old castle that sends out a summons. Facing an unexpected challenge of "life and death," the demons, vampires, werewolves, and angels must try to maintain their neighborly spirit and stick together through the spooky adventure.

results.title: BAKMA
results.overview: In Tunisia, Commissioner Ali and Khaled investigate the ritualistic murder of a young woman. Her limbs have been severed, her head is missing, and in its place, the killer has grotesquely sewn the head of a dog.

results.title: Не по-детски
results.overview: After a major scandal on air, popular TV host Mark Nikolaev tries to restore his reputation and sets out to find Natasha, an orphanage graduate whose victory on a music show sparks a public conflict. However, his attempt to "fix the situation" unexpectedly changes him, forcing him to confront real life for the first time outside the cameras and social media.

results.title: SHIRT!
results.overview: SHIRT! is a dark comedy that explores the notion of nature vs. nurture through the eyes of an adult only child who receives a surprising gift on Christmas morning.

results.title: A Social Contract
results.overview: A Fourth of July dinner turns deadly when a nuclear strike is announced. A helicopter is coming for Senator Wilde—but only three others can join him. Guests fight to prove who deserves a seat before time runs out.

results.title: Don't
results.overview: Two women, Morgan and Rea, relive their past relationship through a series of fragmented memories, revealing not just the past, but the distance between them now.

results.title: Marina Vlady, an Actress During the Cold War
results.original_title: Marina Vlady, une actrice dans la Guerre froide
results.overview: With stars of the screen, it is often only the Edgar Morin-like myth that remains; but viewed close up, an actress’s lifetime has more to do with destiny, and in Marina Vlady’s case, that destiny is unclassifiable, with over eighty classic films and more that were never released. It is across France, Italy, and chiefly Russia that this documentary, chock-full of rare archive material, takes us as it traces the journey of a free woman, making this not simply a documentary but a political film.

results.title: The Loud House: European Adventure
results.overview: The Louds are headed to Europe, where they'll attend a knighting ceremony in London, search for the world's best pizza in Italy, spend a night in a creepy castle in Transylvania, ski the Swiss alps, and time-travel to ancient Greece!

results.title: BeeP
results.overview: BeeP is a mind-bending crime-fantasy about Ilandevan, a young man who can step inside photographs and uncover the thoughts hidden behind them. But when a life-changing event leaves his extraordinary ability useless, he must find another way to uncover the truth while two seemingly unrelated worlds of college dreams, drugs and murder collide.

results.title: Medora: Empress of the Badlands
results.overview: In 1883 Dakota Territory, the Marquis de Mores and wife Medora arrive to build a home, town, and meat empire, facing hostility from ranchers, beef trusts, and violent locals determined to drive them out.
